title: A note write can report busy_budget_exhausted although the note was committed
outcome: A note write can report busy_budget_exhausted although the note was committed
acceptance: Under write contention, a `note` or `gate` either commits and returns success (with the exact persisted locator and a readback command, even when later finalization fails), or does not commit and returns an error; a test reproduces the reported case (error returned, record persisted) and passes after the fix.

completion.summary: A note or gate write that commits but then fails during response finalization (for example busy_budget_exhausted at writer admission) now returns outcome "committed" with the exact persisted locator and a readback command, instead of an error, and a retry does not duplicate it. Uncommitted writes still return the error. Two reproducing tests (note and gate) passed in full gate test-878d6a11 on the landed tree aab6ddcf. Landed in 9f4a1c79, pushed and installed (build 05cc7f06). The independent evaluation 463761e7 passed. Truly unknown outcomes remain the separate open item w-d52974fbf3d4.
